port.ask: Serial port the balance is on (COM6, /dev/ttyUSB0, /dev/tty.usbserial-*)
port.help: RS-232 socket on the balance (9-pin) with a Sartorius data cable to a USB-serial adapter, or the balance's USB port set to SBI (a virtual COM port).

baud.ask: Baud rate as set in the balance's interface menu (factory 9600)
